acceptance_predicates.description: Comparison reports identify missing baseline or candidate provider-selection evidence by side.
Provider/model and execution-binding differences prevent an unqualified comparable claim and are reported as confounders.
Multi-candidate output preserves per-pair and aggregate availability and comparability.
Mock qualification requires no live provider, credential, signature, or key-management service; missing development auth remains a visible warning.

definition_of_done: Exact-main matrix receipt includes available, unavailable, asymmetric, differing-binding, and multi-candidate cases.
Independent review and hosted checks pass with no secret-shaped output.

inputs.description: Baseline and candidate run records with provider/model selection and execution-binding metadata.
Selected development/mock provider and model profile; no production credential is required.

outputs.description: Typed exact-main comparison qualification receipt preserving availability, comparability, confounders, and opaque run identities.

gates.description: No unavailable or provider-confounded pair is reported as comparable.
Reports contain opaque run IDs and no raw paths or credentials.
